test_cltree_basic_isinstance: test that a cltree basic instance is only an instance of basic and not symbol constant or variable
test_cltree_constant_isinstance: test that a cltree constant instance is both a basic and a constant but not symbol or variable
test_cltree_symbol_isinstance: test that a cltree symbol instance is only a symbol and not basic constant or variable
test_cltree_variable_isinstance: test that a cltree variable instance is both a basic and a variable but not symbol or constant
test_cltree_repr_output: test that repr of cltree basic constant and variable instances returns the expected string representations
